prerequisites: A Docker engine (or rootless Docker) is running and reachable
The claim names a disposable real dependency (database, message bus, service)
rollback: Dispose all started containers, networks, and volumes after the proof
Remove temporary test databases created by migrations

hosts.notes: Requires local Docker daemon; unavailable Docker yields explicit UNAVAILABLE evidence, never a silent skip.

notes: Activated only by claims needing real disposable dependencies; never by generic 'integration' wording alone.
Container evidence (container-runtime) proves dependency behavior, not product acceptance by itself.
